top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs two distinct, independently reproduced concepts that each turn a biological process into a defined chemical reaction: base editing as a programmable nucleobase deamination (Liu alone, the cleanest attribution, citation scoped away from prime editing) and induced-proximity protein degradation (Crews and Deshaies, who conceived and first demonstrated it in 2001). It keeps the glue/cereblon strand out of the PROTAC citation, and stays at three names. Risks I accept: no approved degrader, base editing following the 2020 CRISPR prize, and omitted contributors (Komor, Gaudelli, Nishida, Kondo, Ciulli, Handa).
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; the dNTP/genome-maintenance field is adjacent to base editing but I have no stated connection to Liu, Crews, Deshaies, Hartwig, Buchwald, Ciulli or Handa.
